pairs.resume: Business data analyst. Write SQL queries, build Excel models and design Power BI dashboards for weekly reporting and data visualization. pairs.job_description: Business data analyst. Required: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Data Visualization and Reporting. You will support commercial teams with weekly and monthly reporting, partner with finance on budget reviews and present insights to regional managers. Looker experience is preferred. This is a full-time role based in our Lahore office, with two remote days each week. We offer health cover, a learning budget and a yearly team offsite. The office is close to public transport. Our interview process includes a short screening call, a practical exercise and one team interview. We review applications every Monday and aim to reply within two weeks. The office has parking for bicycles.
